> Fact From Story | The U.S. gave more than $500 million to Palestinians from April 2021 through March 2022, including more than $417 million that went to UNRWA.
> > Fact From Story | The U.S. has historically been the single-largest funder of UNRWA, a U.N. agency that relies on governments to support its work.
> > > Fact From Story | $417 million went to UNRWA from the U.S..
> > > Fact From Story | The U.S. gave more than $500 million to Palestinians from April 2021 through March 2022.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge | $417 million is part of $500 million.
> > Commonsense Knowledge | The single-largest funder gives more money than other funders.
> Commonsense Knowledge | Consistently providing the largest amount of funding to an organization over time means being its historically largest funder.
